training_fold_only_filters: remove a feature if it is constant in that training fold
fit any later supervised selector only on that training fold
fit imputation, if ever needed, only on that training fold
selection_policy.t1_prior_policy: At T1, append calibrated out-of-fold T0 probabilities and T0 review priority during training. Never use in-sample T0 predictions as priors.

t0_features.name: linked_record_count
t0_features.reason: Overall evidence volume.

t0_features.name: source_diversity
t0_features.reason: Number of independent evidence domains represented.

t0_features.name: state_missing_ratio
t0_features.reason: Evidence completeness without exposing PII.

t0_features.name: link_confidence_mean
t0_features.reason: Average reliability of frozen linkage decisions.

t0_features.name: oos_share_known_state
t0_features.reason: Balances OOS evidence against DE evidence instead of using OOS count alone.

t0_features.name: distinct_oos_states
t0_features.reason: Separates repeated evidence in one state from multi-state evidence.

t0_features.name: active_address_oos_count
t0_features.reason: Current OOS address evidence.

t0_features.name: active_address_de_count
t0_features.reason: Current DE address evidence that may counterbalance OOS history.

t0_features.name: active_oos_credential_count
t0_features.reason: Explicitly active OOS credential evidence; credential type remains unknown.

t0_features.name: active_de_credential_count
t0_features.reason: Explicitly active DE credential evidence.

t0_features.name: de_count_90d
t0_features.reason: Recent DE evidence volume.

t0_features.name: historical_oos_count_over_365d

t0_features.name: days_since_latest_oos
t0_features.reason: Age of the newest OOS evidence.

t0_features.name: latest_oos_recency_advantage_days
t0_features.reason: Direction and size of the recency difference between latest OOS and DE evidence.

t0_features.name: historical_oos_only
t0_features.reason: Explicit safeguard for old OOS followed by newer DE evidence.

t0_features.name: oos_decay_share_365d
t0_features.reason: Smooth recency-weighted OOS share rather than a hard historical cutoff alone.

t0_features.name: recent_oos_independent_source_count_90d

t0_features.name: recent_latest_source_oos_count_365d
t0_features.reason: Sources whose latest recent state is OOS.

t0_features.name: recent_latest_source_de_count_365d
t0_features.reason: Sources whose latest recent state is DE.

t0_features.name: recent_cross_source_conflict_present_365d
t0_features.reason: Recent DE and OOS sources disagree.

t0_features.name: de_residency_proxy_present
t0_features.reason: Missingness indicator for the non-authoritative DE address-evidence proxy.

t0_features.name: days_past_60_day_grace_proxy
t0_features.reason: Encodes the defensible 60-day review window without asserting a violation.

t0_features.name: post_60d_oos_vehicle_signal_count

t0_features.name: post_60d_prior_state_persistence_any_present
